items.p:
RULE: ser = what/who/where FROM (identity, origin). estar = WHERE something is, and how it is right now.
> Madrid ___ en España.
items.why: Location of a place/thing → estar: Madrid está en España.

items.p:
> Mi hermano ___ profesor.
(My brother is a teacher.)

RULE: gusta + one thing, gustan + several things.
> Me ___ los libros de historia.

items.why: An infinitive counts as singular → te gusta cocinar.

items.p:
RULE: -ar: hablamos · -er: comemos · -ir: vivimos
> Nosotros ___ una carta. (escribir = to write)

Tap the words in order:
Where is the station?

Tap the words in order:
I like Spanish food.

Type in Spanish:
We live in London.

Type in Spanish (vosotros):
Do you all speak English?
